payload: Complete KernelEpochEvent value with no pointers
ordering: Disk sequence numbers order records independently of kernel epochs; explicit session records scope contiguous per-boot epochs
commit: Two metadata sectors follow the data extent. Alternating checksummed generations locate the accepted boundary; deferred flush commits are recovered from a complete contiguous uncommitted tail
checksum: FNV-1a 64 over sector bytes 0..503; corruption detection, not cryptographic authentication
recovery: Opening recovers the boundary without claiming whole-prefix verification. Replay validates every record; physical gaps, epoch gaps, corruption and capacity overflow are refused
scope: Journal core, host SexFiles adapter and native kernel producer qualified. Real-disk recovery and whole-OS state replay remain separate work
